text: 11月11日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京同古巴党和政府特使、古共中央政治局委员、外交部长罗德里格斯举行会谈。王毅说，在两国元首战略引领下，两党两国关系持续发展，传统友谊焕发新的生机活力。中方愿同古方共同落实好两国元首重要共识，不断巩固好、发展好中古友好关系，持续构建更加紧密的中古命运共同体。中方愿同古方加强多边领域沟通协作，继续在多边舞台上相互支持配合，共同反对强权政治和单边行径，推动全球南方的联合自强，构建更加公正合理的全球治理体系。（新华社）
text_en: On November 11, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, held talks in Beijing with Rodriguez, special envoy of the Cuban Party and government, member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of Cuba Central Committee and Foreign Minister. Wang Yi said that under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, relations between the two parties and two countries have continued to develop, and traditional friendship has gained new vitality. China is willing to work with Cuba to jointly implement the important consensus of the two heads of state, continuously consolidate and develop China-Cuba friendly relations, and continue building a closer China-Cuba community with a shared future. China is willing to strengthen communication and coordination with Cuba in multilateral fields, continue mutual support and cooperation on the multilateral stage, jointly oppose power politics and unilateral acts, promote the collective self-strengthening of the Global South, and build a more just and reasonable global governance system. (Xinhua News Agency)
